Results.ReviewText: I am really enjoying this Trager grill. Started by making pulled pork.
Results.Title: Works the first time

Results.ReviewText: Used my new Traeger 650 day 1 with a Brisket then Pime Rib for Christmas Dinner. Fantastic!
Results.Title: First time Smoker!

Results.ReviewText: Should have bought it sooner!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
Results.Title: Don't wait

Results.ReviewText: I Love this new Grill, I have had this grill for a week and have grilled a Brisket, Salmon and a Prime Rib. I love It!! Such an Upgrade from my other Traeger grill!!
Results.Title: This is an Awesome Grill

Results.ReviewText: Smoking is a time consuming hobby that doesn’t fit into everyone’s schedule. Traeger makes it possible to enjoy smoking no matter how busy your schedule.
Results.Title: Worth every penny

Results.ReviewText: Grill was dented upon receipt. Couldn’t use for the holidays which was a bit disappointment.
Results.Title: Damaged Grill

Results.ReviewText: Unboxing was super fun! I already love Traeger! Instructions were very clear and easy to follow.
Results.Title: HIGHLY RECOMMEND

Results.ReviewText: I bought this grill a year ago. Have loved using it from the first use to now. Highly recommend  the Ironwood 885.
Results.Title: Great Features,  Well Built.

Results.ReviewText:
Easy to assemble and easy to use. After an easy to follow burn in process I loaded my new grill up with ribs, wings and pineapple and turned out an amazingly flavored spread. The flavor that was achieved with this first use of my grill left me with no regret in spending the money on a high quality Traeger grill. In assembly and in use it is obvious that attention to functional detail and quality are important to Traeger. Can't wait to put a brisket into this unit! 

The only thing that caught me by surprise in this first use was how little smoke was actually produced. My experience with a Bradly or using smoke tubes in a conventional BBQ made me think that there should be smoke billowing out of this thing. Not how this thing operates, the smoke is subtle and efficient yet produces all the flavor needed.
Results.Title: Very Happy

Results.ReviewText: First round of smoking was amazing! Let’s go again
Results.Title: First time smoker, went great!

Results.ReviewText: Easy to put together and easy to produce excellent smoked food
Results.Title: Excellent smoked food

Results.ReviewText: We purchased a Traeger several years ago and have loved it ever since.  We use it like an oven rarely cooking any meat with the inside ovens.  Now with the family getting smaller as kids move out and starting their own lives we decided to get a smaller grill.  We love all the new features and how fast it warms up and how it is able to stay more constant with the temperature. Bonus on the searing feature and now the WiFi capability, all things that we obviously didn't have on our old grill. The grill was easy to set up delivery was pretty speedy even during the Christmas holiday season. Thank you Traegar for your amazing products.
Results.Title: Loving our Traeger Ironwood Series 650 grill

Results.ReviewText: Great smoker, easy to set up. My only gripe is that it took 15 days from order date to get to me.
Results.Title: Good smoker, shipping time excessive.

Results.ReviewText: Great grill and great wifi technology. Really my only grievance is that the meat probe that comes with the grill is off by about 25 degrees. I have to use my own Bluetooth meat probe which I don't really mind, however I can not "set it and forget it" since the hardwired probe doesn't work properly.
Results.Title: Great grill but meat probe thermometer is way off

Results.ReviewText: Grill has a really bad hotspot.  In addition, their shipping company wouldn't deliver the grill.  I had to drive 4.5 hours to Colorado Springs to pick it up.
Results.Title: Terrible experience

Results.ReviewText: We planned to cook for 30 people with our brand new smoker.  After assembling the unit Christmas morning everyone was excited to for the upcoming feast.   How quickly the anticipation of joy and full bellies turned to frustration when I had to disassemble the unit, check every connection only to find out the unit shipped with a defective blower fan making it a very large, heavy and expensive paperweight.  We scrambled to cook all of this food on a grill, oven, stovetop etc.  Now I wait for the new part to show up and pray it makes the smoker functional.  Every time I use it moving forward I'll remember how much extra work it caused me on Christmas.  Traeger support didn't even offer to send me a gift card, some free pellets or anything.  Let's just say I'm less than impressed.  Maybe the big green egg people are right...
Results.Title: Traeger ruined Christmas

Results.ReviewText: Grill works very well, holds temp in very cold weather, hot spots are minimal. Only down side is the amount of smoke produced.
Results.Title: Very nice grill

Results.ReviewText: This is my third Traeger grill. I bought this one to replace my 780 Pro, which is still going strong and being used by one of my friends. My first grill on this was a Christmas turkey, and it was excellent. The grill maintained temperature better than the 780 in the cold, the pellet sensor was a nice feature, and overall it is an outstanding grill. A very good upgrade.
Results.Title: Review of my new 885

Results.ReviewText: Been recommended a Traeger for years and decided to grab the 885 in the lead up to the Holidays.  Simple to get up and running, simple to learn-as-you-go.  Meat Church and the info available on the app bypasses much of the initial considerations and gets you experimenting.  It’s been running regularly since and we have honestly never eaten so well.  I am not one for phone pics but it’s hard not to want to share the art that comes out of this thing.  Just get one.
Results.Title: Win right out of the gate

Results.ReviewText: Great pellet grill.  Love the wi fi.  Easy to put together.
Results.Title: Love it!

Results.ReviewText: Best purchase of the year. Never thought grilling and smoking could be this essy and fun.
Results.Title: Convert to Traeger

Results.ReviewText: Love the Traeger but the included temp probe is off by around 20F. Only used one time so will check next time.
Results.Title: Almost perfect!

Results.ReviewText: Love the wifire set up and sturdiness over my Lil Texas!
Results.Title: Love it!

Results.ReviewText:
Cooked the chicken challenge and found the recipe temperature of 375 to be way off.
Cean up was very laborious and being only second time using the grill went through practically the whole bag of pellets that came with grill. Figuring out there is a steep learning curve.
Results.Title: Mess to Clean

Results.ReviewText:
The purchase and delivery experience was terrible. Delivery time was stated as 3-4 days and it took approximately 2 weeks to receive.  Called multiple times with no resolution or reasons for the delay.

I’ve used the grill a couple of times and have been impressed with the ease and functionality.
Results.Title: Took forever to arrive but works really well.

Results.ReviewText: Had the Ironwood 650 for a little over a month with 5 delicious meals already made. Brisket, pulled pork, ribs, chicken and ham all perfect! Had an issue with my first grill and Traeger support was quick to respond and resolve my issue. New grill arrived in a few days and everything is perfect. I barely use my stove these days. Looking forward to many more meals on the Traeger!
Results.Title: Fantastic smoker and fantastic customer support!

Results.ReviewText: Easy setup, can’t wait to fire it up! Haven’t cooked on it yet, but planning to smoke something tomorrow.
Results.Title: First time user

Results.ReviewText: Enjoying my new grill so far. Works exactly as expected!
Results.Title: Works well and makes yummy tasting meat

Results.ReviewText: This grill is beautiful! Gets to temp really quickly and holds a lot of food for the size. Huge improvement from my Pro 34. Highly recommended.
Results.Title: Favorite Grill

Results.ReviewText: This grill / smoker is awesome.  Assembly was very simple if you are remotely mechanically inclined.  First night we made reverse seared ribeye steaks, smoked mac & cheese, shrimp skewers & Texas garlic cheese toast, all on the Ironwood and it turned out fantastic and we were hooked!  Since, we have smoked pacific salmon, smoked pork tenderloin and homemade pizza's!  The ironwood is a beast and I love the WiFire app and the ability to set it and forget it.  It's a great product and well worth the money.
Results.Title: Awesome Grill

Results.ReviewText: Second Traeger I’ve owned and they just keep getting better. The previous one had a harder time getting up to a desired temperature during the winter months, but not this one. Would definitely buy it again
Results.Title: Great product

Results.ReviewText: Great grill. Temps are in low 30s to low 20s.  Cooks like a champ.  Wi-Fi control is wonderful.  Pork butt, drum sticks, meatloaf, cheesy grits, madeleine bites. and pan brownies.  All in 3 days.  Exceeded my expectations!
Results.Title: Exceeded My Expectations

Results.ReviewText: This grill is everything I expected. I’ve smoked salmon, chicken and trip already but looking forward to elevating my personal home menu on the ironwood 885.
Results.Title: Everything I expected!

Results.ReviewText: Well built, with lots of upgraded features. This is a replacement for a unit I have had for ten years. I love the wifi. I can cook from my lounge chair.
Results.Title: My upgrade

Results.ReviewText: This grill is awesome.  I pretty much use it exclusively for cooking.  Its features make cooking great tasting meats and vegetables easier than using the oven in my kitchen.  Using the temperature probe and the app on my phone lets me forget about it until the internal temperature is reached, and the alarm goes off on my phone.  My kitchen oven can't do that.  But more importantly the taste and flavor of the food is unsurpassed.  Yes, I love this grill.
Results.Title: I love this grill

Photos.Caption: 19hr smoke, unwrapped to 165 temp, butcher paper wrapped to 202 temp
19hr smoke, unwrapped to 165 temp, butcher paper wrapped to 202 temp

Results.ReviewText: I’ve been using an electric smoker for several years and decided to upgrade to an ironwood 650. I absolutely love it. My first cook was ribs for six hours and it performed flawlessly. My second cook was a 19 hour brisket that I let go overnight and everything worked perfectly. I’m super happy with it and the flavor is amazing. Should have bought it sooner. Definitely get the front shelf add on, very useful. Also, the cover they sell for it is super heavy duty, not light weight and cheap. A must have to protect your investment.
Results.Title: Ironwood 650, Love it!

Results.ReviewText: Just got my Ironwood 885 last week and have already made a few meals on it. I am amazed at how evenly it cooks and how nice it is to be able to cook to an exact temperature. Very happy with it so far!
Results.Title: Ironwood 885

Results.ReviewText: Easy to assemble, the YouTube was very helpful. Worked great the first time. Roasted a half chicken and then did an 8 hour beef rib smoke. Both came out great! I have been smoking meat with traditional smokers for years and this was foolproof with super results. The app was flawless too.
Results.Title: Great product and easy results

Results.ReviewText: Although my grill arrival was delayed, I could not have been more pleased with the ease of assembly and packaging. The box will provide hours of enjoyment for my 22 month old granddaughter.  My wife and I had the grill assembled and in operation in 45 minutes.  I’ve had my grill for a week and have 3 cooks under my belt.  I have made spatchcock chicken, ribs and a meatloaf.  I couldn’t be happier with the quality of all three attempts thus far.  To date, my only issue is with the meat probe as my thermopen is reading a lower temp than the probe.  I’ve checked my thermopen calibration so I am convinced there is an issue with the meat probe.  I plan to do one more cook on a larger piece of meat and double check the probe before reaching out to customer service so I make darn sure it’s not user error.  Overall, exceeding my expectations.
Results.Title: No complaints here

Photos.Caption: Some of the food I’ve done

Results.ReviewText: Been using this model for 1 1/2 years and been loving it ever since I bought it.  Haven’t had any issues and have used it a lot.
Results.Title: Great grille/smoker

Results.ReviewText: Easy to assemble, easy to use, amazing flavors and flexibility with this smoker/grill.  The app is so cool.
Results.Title: Amazing Grill!

Results.ReviewText: Smoker is amazing, holds it's temp well and makes great food. The app on the other hand is garbage, both on Android & iOS. It needs constant closing and reopening to get the current temperature, and the notifications are delayed. Hire whoever made the Anova Precision Oven app to rebuild it, that app is awesome.
Results.Title: Smoker Great - App sub par

Results.ReviewText: I love how easy it is to get great tasting food from the grill! The app is easy to use and the probe tells you exactly when to take the meat off.
Results.Title: Easy and tasty

Results.ReviewText: First few sessions have been great. Love the WiFire ability.
Results.Title: Tastes great

Results.ReviewText: Wow! I had every smoker barbecue out there. This thing is a Beast! It does it all to perfection.
Results.Title: Outstanding Trager

Results.ReviewText: I’ve owned this model for over a year now. Stellar performance and couldn’t be happier. My BFF own a timberline an we both think this is the superior model. I bought this one for my daughter.
Results.Title: So awesome bought another for my daughter.

Results.ReviewText: Bought it for making the Thanksgiving Turkey. Worked even better than my 20yr ols Smith & Wesson Traeger. Only huge disappointment was how I labored over the cost of moving to the larger 850, only to find out it went on sale a week after I bought mine for the same money I paid for the 650. Excruciating when that happens :(
Results.Title: Hate that it went on sale days after I bought it..

Results.ReviewText: I was so excited to finally get me of these smokers. When I got it it did work. I spent two weeks troubleshooting. Still waiting on parts and  no guarantees it will be fixed.
Results.Title: Unhappy Customer

Results.ReviewText: Love the features on the grill and the accessibility of the app! The recipes have helped me with meal planning and I'm aiming to try as many as I can. Would love to see a remote 'Start Up' option as well as an insulated blanket for the Ironwood 885.
Results.Title: Smokin' Recipes

Results.ReviewText: I now have the flat out best grill of all my friends.
Results.Title: Awesome grill

Results.ReviewText:
There has not been one day that passed without having some dish on the Ironwood since I purchased it. When tasting the food, I feel like I've just leveled up to wizard level and that it's impossible to mess up a good piece of meat unless you are trying to. 

Your product quality is exceptional, from the  packaging all the way through to the 
grill and accessories.

Absolutely love it and won't look back! Keep it up!
Results.Title: Pure magic

Results.ReviewText:
I bought this a few weeks ago, I have always wanted a traeger. For my first smoker I actually picked up a green mountain grill. This was a great beginner smoker. But it has many flaws, the app was terrible, smoke flavor was not clean and it always looked dirty due to the matte finish. 

I finally upgraded to a traeger and I never realized how amazing a solid clean smoke flavor will enhance your food! My parents have the pro780 and I thought about going with that but this ironwood 885 with super smoke is a game changer. While writing this I’ve got a 14lb brisket going. And so far it looks and feels like the best one I’ve done yet. With the few cooks I’ve had on this grill. It has really held up to the traeger name. 

Great engineering y’all, 


But if I had one minor complaint, the lid does not seat perfect so smoke and heat are lost out of the gap. It’s tons better than the GMG I had but it’s still there.
Results.Title: Best grill I’ve owned.

Results.ReviewText: Fantastic smoker. Love the wifire. Everyone is begging me to smoke more
Results.Title: Just get it. Glad I went with larger option.

Results.ReviewText:
I've been grilling on my Texas Elite for over 11 years, and still love it.  
When I needed parts, like my recent need a day after Thanksgiving, I was shocked to discover that a lady answered my call (in AMERICA) and I was able to order my parts; and received them less than a week later (free shipping)!!!
Results.Title: Tech Support 365 DAYS A YEAR - from AMERICA!!!!

Results.ReviewText: I received my new Traeger very quickly once I ordered it. It came packaged so everything was perfect inside. Installing it was very easy to do and the unit itself if very high quality. Smoked a Turkey for Thanksgiving and turned out perfect. This is my 3rd Traeger and was not disappointed with my latest choice.
Results.Title: Another great product from Traeger

Results.ReviewText: Love it, use this thing almost everyday.  You wont regret this purchase
Results.Title: Buy this, you wont regret it

Results.ReviewText: I BOUGHT THIS GRILL A LITTLE OVER A YEAR AGO AND LOVE IT .  EVERY RECEIPE FROM THE APP HAS BEEN GREAT!   I SPATCHCOCKED TURKEYS FOR 2ND YEAR AND BETTER THAN MY WIFE'S BAKED IN THE OVEN. LOVE THIS GRILL
Results.Title: GET ONE, YOU WILL NEVER REGRET IT

Results.ReviewText: Love my new smoker/grill. Doesn’t create as much smoke as a traditional smoker but I don’t like my food to taste too smoky anyways so it works out great for me. Love the features the app gives me to be able to control my smoker while cooking
Results.Title: Love this smoker

Results.ReviewText: It's awesome! Made three racks of ribs the first day I put it together. I used your recipe and your app to do it and it worked flawlessly!
Results.Title: Love my new Traeger!

Results.ReviewText: I'm beyond satisfied with the results that are coming from the Ironwood 650 grill. I previously had the Pro 575, but jumped at the opportunity to upgrade when the opportunity presented itself.
Results.Title: Worth the upgrade from Pro series.

Results.ReviewText: Bought a Costco Special in 2019.  Caster recently broke.  Contacted their customer service department and Traeger doesn't offer them for sale and they are difficult to find online.  And when you do........$25 each + shipping.  Doing it again, I'd select another brand.
Results.Title: Parts unavailable.

Results.ReviewText: Works great easy to use thanksgiving dinner was amazing with this smoker
Results.Title: New grill

Results.ReviewText: I cooked 6 different types of meat the last 5 days and they were all perfect.
Results.Title: JR's Real Pit BBQ

Results.ReviewText: I have had Traeger 650 smoker for about 2 years now and it is Awesome. We have cooked Ribs, chicken, burgers, port butt and it is best to cook pizza on.
Results.Title: Great Smoker

Results.ReviewText: This is the the 4th traegar we have purchased over the years and I like this one the best.  It heats up quickly, even in cold temperatures.  The heat maintains itself.  The food cooks evenly and very well.  Really love this one!
Results.Title: FABULOUS PRODUCT

Results.ReviewText:
Upgraded from Camp Chef. I really like this smoker and how well it cooks everything. I love the app and all the recipes and all the extra details Traeger puts into there products.

Im still trying to figure out how to get the best amount of smoke flavor but overall its been fantastic.
Results.Title: Upgrade

Results.ReviewText: A wonderful smoker! It is clear that the folks at Traeger know what they doing and are on top of their user experience. The grill was super easy to set up. The packaging, weirdly enough, was brilliant. And the grill itself works wonderfully. I am glad to have the app and to be able to use it to try out different recipes.
Results.Title: A wonderful smoker!

Results.ReviewText:
Assembly was straightforward and easy. This is a very well made grill and the quality is obvious right out of the box. 
WiFi connection was easy as well and works well. 
I seasoned the grill as described then did my first cook. 
I grill a lot of chicken breast so I wanted to see how this did. I cooked the boneless/skinless breast right out of the package with just some dry rub, set the grill temp to 250 and just let them cook until internal temp was 165 . Everyone in my family agreed that this was the best, juiciest grilled chicken breast they have ever had. 
I love this grill so far and am excited for all of the things it can do. Well worth the money
Results.Title: Great quality, great first experience

Results.ReviewText: We are very pleased with our new grill. Great recovery on temperature from our old treager.
Results.Title: Treager Ironwood

Results.ReviewText: Great grill. Easy to assemble but it was quite heavy. Only thing that surprised me is that super smoke uses a lot of pellets so I wasn’t expecting to burn though that many bags for a massive brisket cooking weeekend
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: Just bought it, set up was easy, looking forward to using it!
Results.Title: Just bought

Results.ReviewText: So far so good.  Everything meets expectations.  Well built.
Results.Title: Treager Ironwood 885

Results.ReviewText: Could great food be any easier?  A little rub, plug it in, turn it on, and wow!
Results.Title: Smoking Good Grill

Results.ReviewText: Bought this about two years ago and we continue to be amazed at the versatility and taste of the food that comes off of it.  I very seldom use the Weber grill anymore and when I do I get asked why I didn't use the Traeger instead.
Results.Title: Replaces the Weber

Results.ReviewText:
good wi fi
super smoke is great
superb temperature control
Results.Title: Ironwood 885

Results.ReviewText: This was a surprise bday gift for hubby and he loves it.  He has been grilling non-stop and reading about different techniques.
Results.Title: Best bday gift

Results.ReviewText: Amazing grill. Food is cooked perfectly with great taste. Wifire makes cooking and monitoring a breeze.  No more "babysitting" a grill all weekend.
Results.Title: So easy

Results.ReviewText: Super Easy to use and looks great.  Came package great and Assembly was a piece of cake.
Results.Title: AMAZING!!!

Results.ReviewText: Had an ash fire flare up on the 3rd cook, and wish there was more of a wood fired or smokey flavor when using hickory pellets. Will keep working at it, but so far this seems to be a good grill and a good smoker, but it is not an exceptional version of either one. Somewhat disappointing for the price paid.
Results.Title: Good smoker and grill, but not great for the price

Results.ReviewText: The ease of use with wi-fire is a huge benefit for those that don’t want to baby sit a smoker. Perfect results with the meat probe. Great product and so easy for the novice to learn!
Results.Title: Great smoker for the first time user!

Results.ReviewText:
I purchased one around a month ago. It's amazing. I have a competition bbq team, and this will be a beautiful gem to help me win!

BUT I have 1 gripe, its not big enough to remove a star.  The top rack is not as stable. I should be able to put 3 10 pound butts on it, per what Traeger has shown capable, but it bows. It bows enough that I have to pick up the rack before I slide out the bottom. Is is annoying to pick it up and then slide out the bottom, yes but who cares. My actual issue with this unfortunate feature?  It presses two butts on top of each other which causes a cook issue.  Maybe it should be 4 stars?
Results.Title: Incredible machine, buy it.

Results.ReviewText: Everything that comes off of this thing is awesome
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText: Bought this September/October of last year. There is nothing I can say bad about it.
Results.Title: IRONWOOD 650. Absolutely love this smoker. 😀

Results.ReviewText: Got my new grill, got it burned in and did my first cook. I was so impressed with the flavor, you would think I was an actual cook. So easy to use. Love it. If you don’t own a Traeger, or haven’t had food off of one. I would highly recommend it. My new Ironwood 885 is an awesome grill.
Results.Title: Love my new Traeger

Results.ReviewText:
I got the ironwood, after having the silverton from Costco.  Would I spend the difference again.. No. super smoke is what I was excited for, but after cooking in both, absolutely no difference.  Never saw extra smoke, tasted just the same.
Ironwood is built better and thicker, so they say less pellets, but price pellets over 5 years and still cheaper on the silverton.  Wifi on both the same. Are they a great grill, yes and why I give 4*, but would stick with the cheaper one since the pellet sensor is useless and super smoke isn’t super anything.
Results.Title: Great grill, but go for the lower priced ones

Results.ReviewText: Replaced an older version with a new Ironwood.  Grill is great, really enjoy how effectively it smokes food and a larger pellet box from my previous version.  Unfortunately the wi-fire is trash.  The app has worked two or three times out of forty or so cooks.  Complete frustration with it.
Results.Title: Still a great grill but

Results.ReviewText: Everything I expected and more! Beautiful grill, easy to operate, and super smoke is SUPER!
Results.Title: THIS GRILL WILL BLOW YOUR MIND!

Results.ReviewText: Have owned Traeger grills since 2007. Little Tex, Little Tex Elite, Pro 22, Pro 575 and now Ironwood 650. The Ironwood is by for the best ever. It holds temperatures well (5-10 degrees ), temperature rebounds when after lid is opened and closed, great smoke flavor (super smoke feature is a plus). I highly recommend the Ironwood. Oh yea for me customer service has been superb over the years.
Results.Title: My best grill ….ever!

Results.ReviewText: The grill is a beast (in a good way). It is solidly built. I put it together in an afternoon and really only needed help getting it on its feet when the legs were installed. I seasoned it and by the evening we were cooking on it. I love that it connected to the Traeger app very easily as well. It cleans up well too.
Results.Title: Excellent Grill

Results.ReviewText: Can't praise this grill enough it does everything and does it very well. Very sturdy and well built.  Only down fall they used FEDEX to ship and Fed ex is a disaster and delayed my shipment which was a Birthday present by 3 weeks
Results.Title: Out standing equipment terrible shipping

Results.ReviewText: Great grill with many features, great for those new to smoking
Results.Title: Great grills for those new to smoking

Results.ReviewText: Wonderful upgrade from my 15yr old Treager that is still alive and kicking at our daughter’s house.
Results.Title: Awesome Ironwood

Results.ReviewText:
Food is good and consistently cooked, but where’s the smoke? If you’re like me and like your BBQ to have a really smoky flavor, you will be disappointed. I totally understand that the visible white smoke is not where it’s at. But I do miss my stick smoker with heavy smoke flavored meats. The ribs I made on my Ironwood 885 were probably the juiciest, most tender, but they lacked smoke flavor. Even with the super smoke mode, there’s nothing.
I did do some research and it may be the Traeger Signature Blend pellets; they’re just too clean and efficient and don’t produce good smoke. I will try that next, as I love everything else about using my Traeger, but I gotta have some smoke flavor!
Results.Title: Where’s the smoke?

Results.ReviewText: I absolutely love this thing.  I had very little BBQ experience when I started shopping for this thing, but my old gas grill had finally given up the ghost after 20+ years.  I had some ribs a friend cooked on theirs and decided to give it a try.  The Ironwood did NOT disappoint!  This thing is the AR 15 of BBQ smokers.  You can buy it (legally) online, put it together yourself, read some passionate literature online, and become very dangerous (to livestock) in a matter of days.
Results.Title: The AR 15 of BBQ grills

Results.ReviewText: I’ve had several different smokers and grills, the ironwood hands down beats them all!
Results.Title: Ironwood Rocks!

Results.ReviewText: The traeger grill is the worst purchase I've ever made in my life. The food comes out pale and tasteless.  Might as well have boiled it on the stove top.  Recommend that anyone who has purchased but has not fired it up yet return it ASAP. Traeger will not take it back once it has been used even one time.
Results.Title: Worst Purchase Ever!!!

Results.ReviewText: Have only used it twice so far. More than I expected. Can’t wait to make all the different recipes in the future.
Results.Title: Traeger 885 review

Results.ReviewText: East to asseble and ready to use in 45 minutes.  New to smoking and pellet smokers.
Results.Title: Assembly

Results.ReviewText: So far so good! I like being able to put food on the smoker and basically forget about it. The Ironwood 885 is very nice. Still trying to figure out my wifi. I think it might be my signal? for some reason my timer worked the first time I used the grill and since then I cannot get the timer to start. I can set the timer to the desired time and when I push the control knob in it moves up to the top right corner but will not start??
Results.Title: Ironwood 885 Review

Results.ReviewText: Easy to use and you can create amazing food. Call center and sales reps are always helpful and give great tips.
Results.Title: All around a great experience
